body.html: Look at Home Lamphun sits at 129/1 Moo 4 in Pa Sak sub-district, Mueang Lamphun · Pa Sak is a suburban area north of Lamphun town, still with a garden-and-paddy feel, but a short drive from the old town and Lamphun railway station · The resort opened in 2018 and was renovated in 2023, so it still looks fresh and clean · It suits self-drivers, with free parking and a fairly quiet location.

The clearest selling point here is the several outdoor pools and a separate shallow kids' pool · The main pool sits in the garden, fine for a relaxed swim, while the shallow kids' pool is safe enough that parents can let children splash without hovering · It's what sets Look at Home apart from similarly-priced stays in Lamphun, most of which have no pool at all · The pools are framed by a garden of trees and flowers, a shaded and photogenic spot.
"Spacious, clean room with a comfortable bed, quiet surroundings, a pool the kids could swim in, friendly staff, an okay breakfast and plenty of parking."

There are about 22 rooms in several styles, from Standard Queen, Superior Twin and Deluxe King to a Family room with four single beds · All rooms have air-conditioning, a flat-screen TV, fridge, hot water, free drinking water and Wi-Fi, and some have a balcony looking over the garden or pool · Real guest reviews often praise the rooms as spacious and clean with comfortable beds · There's an Asian buffet breakfast (charged at around ฿150 per person), a small mini-mart and a taxi-booking service.

To be straight about it, most reviews here are positive, but there is some feedback on service · One overseas guest on a travel site described being moved to a room different from the one booked and having to pay extra, feeling the staff's handling of the issue was inflexible · Although a refund was given in the end, it left a poorer impression · It's a single case that runs against the general praise, but a reminder to confirm your room type and rate clearly at the time of booking to avoid misunderstandings on arrival.

On location, Look at Home is in the quiet Pa Sak area · It's about 14 minutes' drive to Lamphun railway station, with Wat Phra That Hariphunchai and the old town a similar distance away · Chiang Mai Airport (CNX) is roughly 35–40 minutes by car · Being out of the centre keeps it quiet and easy for parking, but it also means you'll need a car to head out for food or an evening wander — there aren't many restaurants within walking distance.

On scores, Look at Home Lamphun performs consistently well · Trip.com gives it 9.2 from 26 reviews and Booking.com sits around 8.9 · The main praise centres on cleanliness, spacious rooms, comfortable beds, the quiet, and having a pool the kids can use · The notes are the occasionally inflexible service and a location that needs a car · Overall it's good value among Lamphun's pool-equipped resorts.

In short, Look at Home Lamphun suits families travelling with children who want a kids' pool, couples after a quiet garden stay, and self-drivers who want a clean, mid-priced room · If you want to stay within the old town to walk to temples and the night market, or you don't have your own car, the Pa Sak location may be less convenient — compare inner-town stays too · But if a pool, cleanliness and quiet are your priorities, it does the job well for the price.

faq.q: Who is Look at Home Lamphun best for?
faq.a: It's a strong pick for families travelling with children, couples after a quiet garden stay, and self-drivers · You get clean, quiet rooms with a pool and free parking · It's less ideal for those who want to stay within the old town to walk around in the evening, or for travellers without their own car.
